items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: The person 'Tisket-a-Tasket' is a song title, not a person. The interviewee refers to the singer as 'this little girl' and 'She', but does not name the singer in the provided text.

ctx.x: What do you mean she outsang her? She --

She took her own number that she made famous and brought the house down. Not because of the fact that she was a local girl, but she really did a job. But she sold, you know, Ella just stood up and sang at that time. This little girl -- "Tisket-a-Tasket" -- did (unintelligible) motions with it. It was a funny thing, you know. We knew that she didn't have the voice or the potential that Ella, but this little girl had drive. She was a saleslady, we'll call her. She knew how to put a tune over. She stayed with me…
Do you have any of these recordings, any of these 78's?
